editorial.blurb: Hunan Bistro delivers authentic Hunan cuisine with tender, perfectly cooked dishes and a lively atmosphere ideal for family gatherings.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early on weekends to avoid parking challenges, and don't miss the dry hot pot and house-made smoked chicken soup—order via QR code if you prefer phone ordering to table-side service.
signatureDishes: Spicy Beef Shank (麻辣大片牛肉)
Dry Hot Pot with Mushrooms & Pork Belly (干锅鹿茸姑)
